messages:
maria: Heads up — getting a surge of 504s from apiserver in eu-west-3 and controller-manager keeps flipping leader. GPU onboarding is piling up in Pending state. Any ideas?
jon: seeing lots of 'failed to renew lease' in controller-manager logs. etcd RTT also spiking around same time.
kevin: logs: ```time=\"2026-03-18T09:02:14Z\" level=error msg=\"failed to update lease: etcdserver: request timed out\"```
nesa: are we hitting any NAT/SNAT limits in that region? We had similar symptoms last quarter.
maria: checked NAT metrics — small bump but not full exhaustion. Proxy (envoy) shows retransmits and 502 backend errors around the same windows.
jon: interesting — proxy retransmits could be increasing apiserver tail latency which then delays lease renewals -> leader election thrash. That would ripple to controller loops (attach/resize).
kevin: GPU attach backlog correlates with a spike in controller-manager requeue depth. queue length jumped from ~30 -> 180 in 3m.
nesa: repro snippet from apiserver traces: ```TRACE: apiserver.HandleRequest duration=450ms peer=10.0.5.12 proto=HTTP2```
jon: 450ms p99 for apiserver is huge for our leader heartbeat. leaderElectionLeaseDuration is 15s, but jitter from proxy is causing renewals to miss.
maria: what immediate mitigation? revert proxy change? Ratelimit?
kevin: suggest temporarily bump controller-manager lease duration to 30s and increase renew deadline, while we roll back the proxy kernel patch that landed at 08:55.
nesa: agree. Also throttle kubelet attach retries to prevent hot-looping on CSI and overloading the attach controller.
sre-bot: action created: SRE-1892 \"eu-west-3 apiserver jitter -> controller-manager leader thrash\" assigned to @maria.
maria: rolling controller-manager deployment with leaseDuration=30s, renewDeadline=20s now (canary 1/3). Watch attach queue.
jon: can we also spin a spare apiserver in same AZ to split load?
kevin: spun one up in az-b (pv access ok) — endpoints updated. Monitoring shows apiserver latency p95 dropping to ~120ms after canary.
nesa: attach queue length decreasing slowly. GPU pending count: was 62, now 18 and trending down.
maria: proxy kernel patch rolled back, no retransmits for last 6m.
jon: cost note: autoscaler had a misconfig that allowed burst of node replacements; that'll show on next invoice for eu-west-3. Opening COST-452 for follow-up.
kevin: data point: extra 24 nodes spun over 40m due to attach retries. Estimate ~0.8k USD for the interval.
sre-bot: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Ticket SRE-1892 updated, postmortem template created.
nesa: follow-up: add e2e watch of leader lease renewals to alert earlier. Also add a runbook step to check proxy retransmit counters.
maria: agreed. I'll own the postmortem and the runbook additions. Thanks all :thumbsup:
jon: nice quick response. we'll close SRE-1892 when postmortem is up.
kevin: leaving some logs in S3: s3://redwood-logs/eu-west-3/sre-1892/ for anyone digging.
maria: note for PMs: no user-facing model traffic impacted for hosted tier, only onboarding/provisioning churn. Communicated to CS.
nesa: moving to monitoring->oncall for watch.
jon: lowering verbosity but keeping an eye.
kevin: 👍
